body: A solo hiking primer that says which trails are fine alone and which are not. I never know which neighborhoods are okay after dark until I am standing in one. Real stories from people who did it last month, with the date and the city. Would love an illustrator to make the checklist look friendly rather than scary.

comments.body: Worth saying the quiet part: if nobody owns the first draft it will stay a thread forever.
I did almost this last spring: start with five people who answer their messages. Fifty strangers is worse.
One worry: prices from last year are already wrong. Put a date next to every number.
